status.en: 20 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% more than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Armed attackers killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in two separate incidents in Oromia, while fighting in Gambella left 12 dead and more than 80 injured, according to MSF. Senior Tigray Military Commander Major General Yohannes was captured near the Eritrean border. The UN reports that over 35,000 Ethiopians have fled across the Kenya border amid the conflict. The conflict has produced 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Bevæpnede angripere drepte minst 60 ortodokse kristne i to separate hendelser i Oromia, mens kamper i Gambella førte til 12 døde og mer enn 80 sårede, ifølge MSF. Senior tigrayisk militærkommandør major general Yohannes ble tatt til fange nær grensen mot Eritrea. FN rapporterer at over 35 000 etiopiere har flyktet over Kenyas grense på grunn av konflikten. Konflikten har forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
